subject: Next steps: vendor intake, approval routing & PO timeline for Helio Health
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Trenton <maya@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: vendor intake, approval routing & PO timeline for Helio Health

Hi Maya — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the pilot + PO forward:

- Decision criteria you called out: inference latency targets for batch jobs, on-prem VPC connectivity, and data residency for PHI.
- Economic buyer: Lisa Monroe (VP Product) — she requested a short TCO estimate and a one-pager on SLA options.
- Procurement path as discussed: vendor intake -> security questionnaire -> legal review -> PO issuance to Redwood Accounts Payable.

As discussed, can you confirm: which internal procurement contact will raise the PO (title/name), and typical PO lead time once legal signs off? Also attaching the SOW draft and our vendor intake checklist so your team can route faster.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Maya to send vendor intake form + security questionnaire to Redwood (we can pre-fill answers).
2) Aditya to follow up with a short technical note on network connectivity and estimated monthly consumption for pilot.
3) Marissa to outline onboarding milestones and invoice cadence (monthly vs. net30).

Attachments: sow-v1.pdf (SOW draft), redwood-vendor-intake-form.xlsx (blank)

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference

From: Maya Trenton <maya@heliohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@heliohealth.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor intake, approval routing & PO timeline for Helio Health

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the procurement path and a few clarifications: 

- Vendor intake will be handled by our Vendor Ops team (Sara Kim, sara.kim@heliohealth.com). I'll loop her in on the intake form.
- Security questionnaire goes to Evan (cc'd) — he typically wants the answers + sample infra diagram.
- Legal: Our counsel team expects standard SaaS terms but will surface any indemnity/data language after reviewing the SOW.
- PO owner: Finance Ops (Charlie Rivera) will issue the PO once legal confirms; typical lead time is 7–10 business days after legal sign-off.

I've attached our completed vendor intake template and the security spreadsheet you'll see Evan references. I'm also adding Lisa (economic buyer) to keep her looped on timeline expectations.

Questions for Redwood: Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts PO to AP@redwood.com and if invoices will be monthly with a net30 term? Also, is the SOW flexible to move the pilot to a fixed-fee milestone structure?

Attachments: helio-vendor-intake-filled.xlsx, helio-security-reqs.xlsx

On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 09:12 AM Maya Trenton <maya@heliohealth.com> wrote:
> Jonas — thanks again. Attaching vendor intake and security checklist.
> 
> -Maya

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Maya Trenton <maya@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor intake, approval routing & PO timeline for Helio Health

Thanks Maya — appreciate the fast turnaround and the completed forms. Quick answers to your questions below and a couple of asks so legal/security have what they need:

- PO and invoices: yes, we accept POs to AP@redwood.com. Invoices are typically monthly by default; net30 is standard but we can discuss milestone invoices if that fits the pilot.
- SOW: we can convert the pilot to a fixed-fee milestone structure; I'll attach a one-page milestone appendix (see attached sow-v1.pdf).

Aditya — can you attach the network diagram and a brief note on the VPC connectivity options and approximate token throughput for a 100k-turn workload? Evan — in the security spreadsheet I answered several controls already; attaching security-answers-helio.docx for anything we left blank.

Next asks from Helio to keep momentum:
1) Sara Kim to formally submit the intake into your vendor portal (or confirm you can accept via email).
2) Charlie Rivera (Finance) to confirm PO owner contact info and whether they require a W-9 before PO.
3) Legal to advise on any data residency clauses; Lisa if you can confirm whether the pilot will require PHI-level handling or de-identified data only.

I'll follow up Monday with the milestone appendix and a short cost estimate for the pilot.

Best,
Jonas

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@heliohealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Trenton <maya@heliohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Monroe <lisa.monroe@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: vendor intake, approval routing & PO timeline for Helio Health

Jonas / Aditya — reviewed the security answers and the SOW appendix. A few security items to close before we can move to legal review:

- Please provide the network diagram and sample architecture showing where PHI (if any) will be processed and stored; include details on encryption at rest and in transit.
- Confirm whether Redwood will host any persistent logs containing PHI and, if so, retention policy and access controls.
- We need a SOC2 report or a third-party put on the table (or timeline when Redwood can provide SOC2 Type II).

Assuming those items are addressed we will push the package to legal. For the procurement timeline: once legal signs off we expect Finance to issue a PO within 7 business days; once PO is issued, AP will require a W-9 and a PDF of the signed SOW.

Can you provide the above by next Tuesday so we can hit a mid-August kickoff?

Thanks — Evan
Evan Brooks | IT Security Lead, Helio Health
evan.brooks@heliohealth.com | +1 617 555 0220
